endpoints.summary: Recent news about a company by domain — provider-native article/event rows in `articles`

input.note: Send everything you know about the subject — treg derives the rest (full_name ⇄ first+last), matches each provider on the variants it accepts ({domain}) and sends each provider only the fields it wants. On a miss treg keeps trying providers, cheapest first, within X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost (default $1 per call; misses on per-success providers are free). Options ride as headers, never in the body: X-Treg-Route-Waterfall: 0 (stop at the first miss), X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost: <usd>, X-Treg-Route-Prefer / X-Treg-Route-Exclude: <provider>. The response is {output, raw, _treg: {served_by, tried}}; X-Treg-Served-By names the child.

cost.note: NOT free: misses are billed too. the children's range $0.01–$0.04 per hit, 0% markup; you pay the child that served AND every child tried before it that bills a miss (2 of 2 do), up to X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost (default $1 a call). X-Treg-Route-Exclude them, or X-Treg-Route-Waterfall: 0, to pay for one provider only
